lessons.title: Never take accountId from the request body
lessons.description: The first version of PATCH /invoices/:id spread req.body into the update, so a caller could move an invoice to another account.
lessons.fix: Read accountId only from the session. Allowlist updatable fields in every controller.

lessons.title: Webhook handlers must be idempotent
lessons.description: The provider retries webhooks. A retried payment.succeeded event marked an invoice paid twice and sent two receipts.
lessons.fix: Store the provider event id with a unique constraint and skip events already processed.

lessons.title: Format money once, at the edge
lessons.description: InvoiceTotal.jsx divided cents by 100 and the API also sent dollars, so totals showed 100x too small.
lessons.fix: The API always returns integer cents. Only formatMoney() in web/src/lib/money.js converts for display.

lessons.title: Every list needs an empty state
lessons.description: New shops saw a blank page on Invoices because the list rendered nothing for zero rows.
lessons.fix: Render an empty state that says what to do next (Create your first invoice).

lessons.title: Migrations live in db/migrations, not server/
lessons.description: A migration added under server/src/migrations was never run in CI.
lessons.fix: Put every migration in db/migrations/ with a timestamp prefix.
